newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Foreign investors buy more Pakistan stocks in Mar.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investors buy more Pakistan stocks in Mar.

text.p: Foreign investors purchased 28.16 million shares worth 965.16 million rupees in March compared to 21.12 million worth 862.63 million in February, one official of the Karachi Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.
Foreign investors sold 21.06 million shares worth 651.62 million in March compared to 42.71 million worth 1,314.10 million in February, the official said.
The investors included foreign fund managers and Pakistanis living abroad, one stock broker said.
